rules.text: Online purchases can be returned or exchanged within 30 days from the delivery date.
rules.quote:
30 Days to Return or Exchange
    *   From the delivery date for online purchases

rules.text: Premier Encore Members have up to 45 days to return items.
rules.quote:
Some Encore Members have extended return windows:
    *   Premier Members have up to 45 days to return

rules.text: Nonmembers pay a $6 return fee for returns by mail.
rules.quote: A $6 return fee applies to returns by mail from nonmembers

rules.text: Encore Members get free returns by mail.
Items shipped and sold by third-party sellers are eligible for free returns.
rules.quote: Items shipped & sold by third-party sellers are eligible for free returns.

rules.text: Items purchased on third-party sites or apps follow the return policies of those sites.
rules.quote: Items purchased on third-party sites or apps are subject to the return policies of those sites.

rules.text: Returns after 30 days receive a Merchandise Return Card (MRC) instead of a refund.
rules.quote: Returns after 30 days will receive a Merchandise Return Card (MRC).

rules.text: Eligible purchases are required for free in-store returns and exchanges.
rules.quote:
Free In-Store Return and Exchange
    *   Available for eligible* purchases
